proposedBellaRules.scope: Project lookup inside an already-read supported OMF1/Bento1. Existing reading, identity and text rules remain agreed. No runtime code/cutover, Bin Filter change, new header-open reason or final cross-source priority.
ownerOrder: Only if no usable file-owned result: qualified immediately linked source records
ownerLocalKeyOrder: Exact _PJ inside one exact owner-local _USER object-attribute list
proposedBellaRules.text: Use the already agreed typed representation: legacy Kind2 MacRoman; established marked Unicode layout with checked requested text name, kind/type, two-zero marker, bounded strict UTF-8 and required framing. Kind3 is a checked list reference. Neither key name nor Kind4 alone proves Unicode. No invented paired backup, Unicode-byte MacRoman retry or arbitrary UTF-8 guessing.
proposedBellaRules.fallback: Missing, empty, whitespace-only or individually unusable candidate can advance when owner/boundaries remain safe. Unicode preference applies to a proven representation of that candidate, not a lower-priority key or owner. Preserve exact nonblank spelling/spacing.
proposedBellaRules.sources: Use only supported complete file-local component/SourceID links and complete normalized identities to active qualified immediate sources. Apply the same local key order. One distinct usable source Project, or exact agreement among several, supplies the value. Do not search master, arbitrary import settings, unrelated objects or deeper source ancestry.
proposedBellaRules.conflicts: Conflicting usable same-priority/key values or incomplete/ambiguous required relationships leave OMF contribution unavailable. Do not hide conflict by choosing a lower key/source, first/last item, date or hash order. Missing source values are normal. General OMF damage review remains later.
proposedBellaRules.retention: Keep selected owned QString and necessary compact availability/owner/key context. Release temporary bytes/indexes/links. Small fixed key table and shared helpers; no generic inheritance engine or permanent alternate-Project history.
proposedBellaRules.missingAndDisplay: No fabricated parser Project from current Avid project, folder, volume or clip/master name. Keep physical row and independent facts. Existing current UI No project label is separate from raw empty value and is unchanged by this review.

minimalBellaProposalAwaitingApproval: Use file-first Project ownership independently of selected master, following the already agreed MDB owner/key principle where supported by OMF native/actual evidence. Do not copy the MXF Preface-first rule; OMF has no reviewed equivalent header Project field.

On the qualified physical file mob, try exact direct _PJ, exact direct PROJNAME, then exact local _USER object-list _PJ. Do not flatten arbitrary nested attributes or import settings. Apply the approved Kind2 MacRoman / recognized marked Kind4 Unicode decoder to the actual known representation.

Treat missing, blank or individually unusable text as no value when boundaries remain safe. Whitespace-only is blank; preserve spelling and all surrounding/internal whitespace for a nonblank value. Conflicting usable duplicates at the same exact priority make Project unavailable rather than concealing conflict through fallback.

If the file has no usable local Project, consider only its qualified immediately linked source records with the same local candidate order, as already agreed for MDB. Accept one distinct usable result; reject unresolved differing values or incomplete/ambiguous relationships. This is a proposed OMF policy, not already approved by this source audit or a native universal policy.

Do not use selected master Project, arbitrary deeper source ancestry, current project context, path or filename as a fallback. Keep compact selected text/availability/needed owner-key context and release temporary attributes and links.

Leave unavailable OMF-derived raw Project empty and retain physical row, IDs and independent fields. Current No project display/CSV label is separate from parser state; do not silently claim or implement a UI change. Final cross-source priority remains later.
